description: This script analyzes TypeScript source files in a project to verify that certain plugin SDK subpaths are correctly exported and referenced. It reads project configuration files, collects TypeScript files, parses module specifiers, and reports violations related to missing exports.

methods.name: readPackageExports
methods.description: Reads and returns the set of exported plugin SDK subpaths from package.json.

methods.name: readEntrypoints
methods.description: Reads and returns the set of plugin SDK entrypoints from a JSON file.

methods.name: parsePluginSdkSubpath
methods.description: Extracts the subpath from a plugin SDK module specifier if it matches the expected prefix.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting violation entries.

methods.name: collectViolations
methods.description: Main logic for collecting violations of missing plugin SDK exports in the TypeScript files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that calls collectViolations and outputs the result, or success message.
